newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins slip on Dow, seen edging down.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins slip on Dow, seen edging down.

text.p: Russian MinFin bonds fell in thin trade on Monday on general market pessimism after the sharp fall in the Dow Jones index, but the move hit strong support after a few hours of trade, dealers said.
They forecast the market would slip further in the next few days.
tranche Aug 18 Aug 15
"MinFins slipped in the morning mainly due to the fall of the Dow Jones (index) and the general pessimistic mood on the markets," an International Moscow Bank dealer said.
He forecast a further fall in prices as some banks feared the Federal Reserve's Open Market Committee would hike its interest rates at the meeting on Tuesday.
Prices of MinFin bonds, like other debt, would be vulnerable to a rise in interest rates which could prompt a shift out of securities into cash.
The International Moscow Bank dealer said a rise of the mark against the dollar made investment into dollar-denominated paper less attractive, which could also spark sales in MinFins.
But a Sberbank dealer said the market was sure the Fed would not raise interest rates and forecast range-bound trading in the next few days.
"No one doubts that they won't hike the rates," he said.
Dealers said MinFin bonds hit a strong support level after a morning slip. Tranches 4, 5 and 6 were the most actively traded.
"As soon as the market started falling, support appeared," the Sberbank dealer said, estimating Monday's volumes at $200-$300 million nominal.
The International Moscow Bank dealer said the support level for tranche 4 was 70.30 and for tranche 5 53.20, adding the market had slipped by about 0.5 basis points.
Dealers said most sales came from London, on fears of a U.S. rate hike.

The International Moscow Bank dealer said Moscow banks preferred to hold long positions, hoping for a quick close of the rescheduling agreement with the London Club of commercial bank creditors and a possible upgrade of Russia's international credit rating.
